facts.fact: The article says law L/2017/031/AN of 4 July 2017 on Inclusive Financial Institutions defines licensed institutions, including e-money institutions (EME), serving people outside the traditional banking circuit.
facts.system: Law L/2017/031/AN on Institutions Financieres Inclusives

facts.fact: The article says the 2017 law counts licensed e-money institutions (EME), microfinance institutions and postal financial services as inclusive financial institutions.
facts.system: Law L/2017/031/AN on Institutions Financieres Inclusives
